##### Project general facts

Damac Hills – Belair Phase 2 is an exclusive villa and mansion community located within Trump Estates at DAMAC Hills, Dubai. Positioned inside a private gated enclave surrounded by the greenery of a championship golf course, the project is designed to deliver a refined residential experience inspired by contemporary Californian luxury living. The development combines spacious architectural layouts with elegant modern design, creating a premium suburban environment focused on privacy, open space, and upscale community living.

Residents benefit from the extensive lifestyle infrastructure of DAMAC Hills, including access to landscaped parks, golf facilities, leisure areas, sports amenities, and premium community services. The project’s gated setting within Trump Estates enhances exclusivity and security, while the surrounding green spaces and golf course views create a calm resort-like atmosphere. The overall concept emphasizes spacious family living combined with luxury amenities and a prestigious address within one of Dubai’s most recognized villa communities.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials throughout, reflecting a modern luxury residential standard designed for both comfort and elegance. Kitchens come fully equipped, offering practicality alongside contemporary styling. The villas and mansions are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the flexibility to customize interiors according to their personal preferences while maintaining the project’s upscale architectural character.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
